title: Kejatuhan
Jensen Huang
intro_say: Biar saya terangkan isu ini... di antara dua hirupan kopi.

panel.prompt: Vertical video, macro shot. A silicon wafer and a computer graphics chip under dramatic cool lighting, tiny reflections sweeping across the circuits, slow rotation. Clean, technical, high detail. Soft electronic hum, no music, no speech, no text, no logos.

Vertical video, vintage 1960s film look, grainy, sepia tones. A quiet street in old Taipei, Taiwan, with low shophouses and bicycles. A family seen only as dark silhouettes from behind, walking away from the camera. Slow push-in. Soft ambient street sound, no music, no speech, no text, no faces.

say: Nvidia buat cip GPU... cip yang boleh buat ribuan kiraan serentak.

panel.prompt: Vertical video. A long corridor of data-centre server racks glowing with green and blue lights, camera gliding slowly forward, lights pulsing like data flowing. Cool, powerful mood. Low machine hum, no music, no speech, no text, no logos.

say.say: Hari ini, Nvidia kuasai hampir sembilan puluh peratus pasaran cip AI dunia.
say.show: Hari ini, Nvidia kuasai hampir 90% pasaran cip AI dunia.

panel.prompt: Vertical video, moody and tense. A dim, closed meeting room seen through frosted glass. Several businessmen appear only as blurred dark silhouettes around a table, no faces visible. A desk lamp flickers slightly. Slow, steady camera. Quiet room tone, no music, no speech, no text.

say.say: Tapi pada lapan November, lembaga Nvidia buka siasatan.
say.show: Tapi pada 8 November, lembaga Nvidia buka siasatan.

say.say: Huang didakwa rapat dengan seorang wanita yang disyaki perisik China.
say.show: Huang *didakwa* rapat dengan seorang wanita yang disyaki perisik China.

say: China dan syarikat wanita itu menafikan.

say.say: Empat hari kemudian, dua belas November... Huang letak jawatan.
say.show: Empat hari kemudian, 12 November... Huang letak jawatan.

say.say: Tiga puluh tiga tahun sebagai CEO, berakhir.

say: Kenapa ini penting? Sebab cip AI ialah minyak abad ke-21.

head.sub: Amerika sekat cip AI ke China

panel.caption: Sekatan eksport cip AI canggih sejak 2022

say: Sejak 2022, Amerika sekat eksport cip AI canggih ke China.

say.say: Dan Malaysia? Kita kendalikan tiga belas peratus pemasangan dan ujian cip dunia.
say.show: Dan Malaysia? Kita kendalikan 13% pemasangan dan ujian cip dunia.

say: Bila gergasi bergaduh... kita di tengah.
